reason: Money is tight since daycare went up, and we do library storytime, parks and the zoo for free. $13 a visit adds up fast, and I'd maybe go once or twice a month, so a membership makes no sense.
objection: We'd only go once or twice a month, and $13 a kid plus a sibling is real money when free places already keep my kids busy.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $7 to $8 per child, or a free or very cheap weekday session I could use now and then.
